slice.title: Customer directory
slice.goal: Build the initial customer directory prototype: list customers, create customer records, edit contact data, and search customers by name/email/phone using local JSON mock storage.
acceptance_criteria: User can see a list of customers with full name, email, phone, and segment.
User can create a customer with full name, email, phone, and segment.
User can edit an existing customer's email and phone.
User can search customers by name, email, or phone.
The main screen and interactive controls have stable data-prototype-id anchors linked to scheme elements.
The prototype uses local JSON mock storage and does not require external integrations.
constraints: No customer deduplication or MDM golden-record matching in this slice.
Use local JSON mock storage from the sample mock plan.
No new dependencies beyond the selected kit.
Do not implement delete customer in this slice.

notes: This scenario intentionally differs from tasks-app: it has no status enum or status filter, and search should work across name, email, and phone fields.
Use it to check whether CRUD/list/search test method contracts generalize beyond notes/tasks examples.
